g.text: GrowTH is the intelligent companion for parents, providing actionable insights
and calm tracking for your child's developmental journey.
Monitor growth metrics with professional precision on any device.
Designed specifically for proactive parents, GrowTH translates complex
developmental data into simple, actionable insights. We believe in
providing clarity over clutter, so you can focus on what matters most —
Log milestones and physical growth with
Bone age screening support, in one place.
Expert articles to guide you through every stage.
When the pubertal growth spurt happens, how fast it goes,
and which changes are worth a doctor’s attention.
Calcium, vitamin D, iron and protein targets for ages 9–13 —
and the everyday habits that matter more than any single
How skeletal maturity is read from a hand X-ray, why a
doctor would order one, and the limits of what it can tell you.
